decisions.reason: The black-finish range is a cheap finish variant of existing drains that still has upside from the design trend, so the option stays open at little cost.
The seamless-covering shower channel sits close to the core offer and suits barrier-free bathroom architecture, so its holding cost is low and its prospects remain good.
The newer pump-drain shower channel F overlaps this line and raises the chance that C is replaced, but the evidence does not yet justify abandoning its renovation applications.
The stainless steel design grate uses the firm's own manufacturing at low marginal cost and has its own page, so keeping it remains clearly worthwhile.
The pump-drain channel was only launched in 2024 and has a dedicated page, so its value is still uncertain and the option should be kept open.
